meanings.dedup_similarity: content-word overlap at or above which a new line counts as already said
meanings.demote_candidates: how many weakest/oldest lines a cap refusal names as demote candidates
meanings.heavy_prompt_tokens: reference heavy prompt, in tokens — the 100% the cost reader compares against
meanings.max_chars_default: WHOLE-CARD character cap for a card with no cap of its own (what it costs)
meanings.max_entry_chars: longest ONE entry may be before the door forces a note-file split
meanings.max_lines_default: ENTRY-COUNT cap for a card with no cap of its own (how many things to read)
meanings.probe_turns: how many turns the compose probe composes when proving a write
meanings.slowdown_step: how many turns the auto-slow rule adds to a crossing card's every-N
meanings.slowdown_threshold: entry count a card crosses to trigger the auto-slow rule ([hidden], 2026-09-01)
